[[Curses]] | damagetype = [[Dark damage]] | icon = Dead Sword }} [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. == Stats == :[[Dark damage|Dark Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Blood Magic]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Curses]]) :[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of [[spell]]s during [[Special event|Festival events]]. (Chance: 20%) No effect in [[PvP]]. :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of spells (Chance: 10%) :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== It uses the [[Dead Sword]] [[skin]]. This skin is normally exclusive to [[sword]]s, although in this case it works as a wand. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the universal "20% chance of halving casting time of spells" mod is not available outside of the unique Decade weapons. ==Notes== *[[Bazzr's Wail]] is the only other Death Magic wand that deals dark damage and not [[cold damage]]. *Like other equipment with multiple attribute requirements, the damage property will count once no matter how many different requirements are met. *The inherent bonus [[HCT]] effect during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Wand]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]] [[Category:Multiple attribute items]] [[Category:Weapons with irregular skins]]
